summary: No further evidence or change is available within this turn's remaining time, so the previously accepted submission stands unchanged (recorded as no change rather than a duplicate revision). The research record is currently coherent: one asserted defect (shouldSnapshot underflow producing redundant snapshots at an unchanged index, witnessed by CheckRun 9cba2e79ff6c4019b0f0381690d9aaab with its reachability limits corrected after the user-restore producer was measured not to trigger it, CheckRun b78bcab64b0d41b5adaafa98cc0c7f43), three refuted suspicions (non-voter commit eligibility, post-restart vote duplication, AddVoter configuration lag) each with retained operands, and three durable Behaviors/Facts. The single remaining open item is the snapshot-install producer on a follower, which the source reading predicts can empty the store on a monotonic log store and which still needs its own fixed experiment.
